sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:157

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:157:1
items.html: The upper Mochin awaken and return and come by themselves, without our needing to bring new Mochin through the Shema: For although the Mochin of ZON face to face depart after the morning prayer, nevertheless ZON do not return to their Katnut because of this; only the discernment of face to face departs from them. And therefore in the Mincha prayer, where this entire coupling is only a coupling of posterior, which is the secret of the coupling of Israel and Leah from the Chazeh upward, and Rachel is then found in the posterior at an equal level with ZA, as will be said in its place. Therefore this coupling is reckoned only as the discernment of the awakening of the upper Mochin, and here they do not need to raise MAN through the Shema, as in the preparation of the coupling of the morning prayer, for here there are no new Mochin that would require raising MAN anew.
